body:
The accepted e000 baseline has native guarded record writers, general approval-free
mapping receipts and immutable reviewed exporters, but its current canonical and
policy writers are explicitly bound to #1149/receipt 27 and two source owners.
Native probes against the actual current endpoint refuse both writers. Historical
Step 7d/deferred-alias publishers bind different old baselines and scopes.

Provide a bounded plan-driven campaign publisher plus an independently checked,
closed policy-history entry. Preserve every existing policy decision/history and
receipt; bind complete current before/after owner inventories and exact native
generation/receipt endpoints. Preserve historical owner attribution with verified
native bridges, rather than silently relabeling all old pins as current. Every
changed canonical cell and suppression disposition needs a trace. Use native
guarded publication with reserved receipts and late inventory/alias checks.

No new receipt format or companion refresh adapter is required. A genuinely fresh
20-owner/51-claim companion scientific review can use the existing native contract
and exporter; if any scoped mapping loses support, report that native boundary
rather than dropping it or approving it mechanically. New external-ontology rows
remain WITHHOLD pending the separate #1165 admission work and exact science.

Acceptance: pinned positive multi-owner/new-owner/source-only/history-bridge fixtures;
negative unknown-field, old-history rewrite, missing/extra source or row, stale/alias/
late substitution, approval-transfer and incomplete publication cases; all native
receipt, QC, export and review gates unchanged. Implementation can be prepared on
fixtures now; actual publication waits for the fully reconciled accepted campaign.

Evidence: private campaign-publication-prereq-v1/ASSESSMENT.md, probe-results.json,
fresh-companion-results-v2.json and historical-owner-bridge.json. This is a capability
gap, separate from #1150 compatibility and #1165 scientific positive admission.

Exact source baseline: `e000d66dd26ab053e9b17ce7bf8d3c873c3dde99` (unmerged dependency #1158). The independent assessment is `.temp/all-unmatched-20261107/preflight/campaign-publication-prereq-v1/ASSESSMENT.md`, SHA256 `8f60f67514f47e277736e6ad0f87b8e162ea13ebf2b6a4eab68d80f01321ced4`; its bounded manifest is `9b666ecf35ea80e405390356267e3d380c84763b32346e078791f7ad4adc2880`. The alternative search included ignored files.

Source application must also preserve genuine unmapped preimages for promoted records: retain explicit old/new paths, backup hashes and history in the source apply receipt rather than misclassifying a move as a new identity. No production curation has been applied. The isolated coordinator branch is `curate/all-unmatched-source-integration-20261107`; final reconciled scientific intake remains a prerequisite.
title: Add a closed multi-owner campaign canonical and policy publication contract
